title: Python ML: Data Distributions
description: In the real world, data sets can be huge. To work with big data, we need to understand how the data is scattered or distributed. NumPy's random module allows us to create random sets of data of any size, following specific distributions like Uniform or Normal (Gaussian) distributions.
example:
# Uniform Data Distribution
import numpy
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = numpy.random.uniform(0.0, 5.0, 250) # 250 random floats between 0 and 5

# Normal Data Distribution (Bell Curve)
x = numpy.random.normal(5.0, 1.0, 100000) # mean 5, std dev 1, size 100k
plt.hist(x, 100)
plt.show()
